title: Autonomous Baltic Cold-Chain Telemetry & Compliance Platform PRD

items.text: Perishable cargo losses in Baltic transit due to undetected reefer temperature deviations.
Fleet managers need continuous temperature visibility without manual driver logbook checks.
Automated IoT sensor telemetry streaming directly to dispatcher dashboard with edge caching during cellular dead zones.
Low-power Bluetooth 5.2 edge nodes communicating with cab gateway; fallback to local flash storage during offline transit.
P0: Real-time temperature and humidity streaming with <=60s latency over 4G/LTE.
P0: Automated SMS and webhook alert dispatch upon breach of HACCP temperature thresholds (+/-0.5C).
P1: Offline cryptographic data sealing on edge gateway with automatic sync upon reconnection.
Given a temperature spike above 4C for >180s, when detected by edge probe, then trigger alert within 15 seconds.
Extreme cold battery degradation leading to unmonitored transit windows.
Dispatcher inspects live map view of active trucks with colored temperature badges (Green = OK, Amber = Warning, Red = Breach).
Reduce temperature breach response time from 45 minutes to <2 minutes across a 60-day Baltic pilot fleet.
Assumes continuous vehicle auxiliary power availability during transit.
Deploy hardware prototype on 5 test vehicles on the Riga-Tallinn route.
